reapack.name: ReaPorter.lua
reapack.desc: ReaPorter: convert plugin-vendor presets into REAPER presets

version.author: Toms
version.changelog: First public release. Converts the presets of DMGAudio, Eventide, FabFilter, LiquidSonics, Relab (LX480 v4), Reverb Foundry (Tai Chi), Soundtoys 5 and Valhalla DSP plugins that are already on this computer into REAPER user presets, with a backup of every preset file it changes.
